item.title: The Irishman who composed Japan's national anthem
item.description: William Fenton created the first version of Japan’s national anthem “Kimigayo” in 1870.

item.title: Love, loyalty and friendship: Everything to know about the Claddagh Ring
item.description: There's a beautiful old Irish saying that goes along with giving a Claddagh Ring, 'With these hands, I give you my heart and crown it with my love.'

item.title: On This Day: Dublin Gothic writer Joseph Sheridan Le Fanu died in 1873
item.description: Today we remember Joseph Sheridan Lefanu, the Irish literary talent behind most of the spooky vampire tales we know and love today.

item.title: When Charles Dickens visited Ireland
item.description: Charles Dickens, who was born on February 7, 1812, visited Dublin, Belfast, and Cork while on a book tour of Ireland in 1858.

item.title: Love songs and poems from the great Irish writers for Valentine’s Day
item.description: Looking for something special for the inside of your Valentine's Day card? Try out these poems and songs from some of the best Irish writers in history.
